title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — November 23, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B2.3 (Peaked November 23, 2026 at 19:41 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 317 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)

Pretty calm right now. 💫

A broad dark coronal-hole-like region and several bright active regions stand out today, while the coronagraph view looks routine.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
